body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2008') -- <Visual News> Vuzix(www.vuzix.com) presented its virtual video iWear 'AV920-C' allowing multiplayer gaming during CES 2008.
Adopting two LCD displays with 640 x 480 resolution, the AV920-C enables users to view large-size video or pictures equivalent to a 62-inch screen as seen from 2.7 meter away.
